chains.title: C1: T allele creates a stronger FOXA1 enhancer site that increases TOX3 expression.

links.claim: FOXA1 binds the T allele of rs4784227 more strongly than the C allele; QBiC-SELEX coverage is not_checked because no QBiC-SELEX evidence was supplied.
rs4784227 lies in a putative TOX3 enhancer in 16q12 that is active in breast epithelial cells.
This enhancer regulates TOX3, the nearest 16q12 breast-cancer-associated gene.
The mechanism operates in MCF7-like luminal breast epithelial cells.
T-allele-driven increased TOX3 expression raises breast cancer risk.

predictions: T allele binds FOXA1 more strongly than C in EMSA and in allele-specific ChIP.
The variant lies in an enhancer active in luminal breast cells.
Higher FOXA1 occupancy increases TOX3 expression in MCF7-like cells.
Increased TOX3 dosage promotes breast cancer risk.
falsified_if: No allele-specific FOXA1 binding at rs4784227 is reproducible.
The element shows no rs4784227-dependent enhancer activity or TOX3 expression effect in breast cells.

chains.title: Null: rs4784227 has no TF-mediated allelic effect; association is via linkage or passenger mechanism.
predictions: No reproducible allele-specific TF binding at rs4784227.
No rs4784227-dependent enhancer activity or TOX3 expression difference.
Disease association is explained by a linked causal variant or by chance/passenger effects.
falsified_if: A reproducible allele-specific TF binding and enhancer/expression effect at rs4784227 is demonstrated in breast cells.

chains.title: C2: T allele disrupts a FOXA1 enhancer site, lowering TOX3 expression.

links.claim: FOXA1 binds the C allele of rs4784227 more strongly than the T allele; QBiC-SELEX coverage is not_checked because no QBiC-SELEX evidence was supplied.
rs4784227 lies in a putative TOX3 enhancer in 16q12.
The relevant cells are MCF7-like luminal breast epithelial cells.
Reduced TOX3 expression increases breast cancer risk.

predictions: C allele binds FOXA1 more strongly than T in EMSA and allele-specific ChIP.
The variant lies in a TOX3 enhancer active in breast cells.
Lower FOXA1 occupancy at T decreases TOX3 expression if FOXA1 is activating.
Altered TOX3 dosage changes breast cancer risk.
falsified_if: No allele-specific FOXA1 binding with C stronger than T is reproducible.
The element shows no rs4784227-dependent TOX3 expression effect in breast cells.

chains.title: C3: T allele strengthens a GATA3 enhancer site and increases TOX3.

links.claim: GATA3 binds the T allele of rs4784227 more strongly than the C allele; QBiC-SELEX coverage is not_checked because no QBiC-SELEX evidence was supplied.
rs4784227 lies in a GATA3-responsive TOX3 enhancer in 16q12.
GATA3 binding at this element regulates TOX3.
The mechanism operates in MCF7-like luminal breast epithelial cells.
GATA3-driven TOX3 expression raises breast cancer risk.

predictions: T allele binds GATA3 more strongly than C.
GATA3 occupancy at rs4784227 is detectable in breast cells.
GATA3 binding increases TOX3 expression in luminal breast cells.
TOX3 increase raises breast cancer risk.
falsified_if: No allele-specific GATA3 binding at rs4784227 is reproducible.
GATA3 occupancy at this element does not affect TOX3 expression in breast cells.
